title_sq: SHITET APARTAMENT ME POST PARKIMI TEK AMBASADOR 3
description_sq: Shitet apartament me post parkimi tek Ambasador 3, ne nje nga zonat me te kerkuara te Tiranes. Ndodhet ne katin e 14-te te nje godine moderne, me siperfaqe 120.8 m² dhe post parkimi 12.5 m² ne katin -1, i perfshire ne cmim. Apartamenti ofron pamje nga Liqeni i Tiranes dhe Stadiumi Air Albania, ndricim natyral dhe orientim shume te mire. Organizimi perfshin sallon me kuzhine, dhome gjumi me garderobe, tualet, lavanderi dhe ballkon, me mundesi konvertimi ne 2+1. Ideal per banim ose investim afatgjate.
title_en: APARTMENT FOR SALE WITH PARKING POST AT AMBASSADOR 3
description_en: Apartment for sale with parking station at Ambasador 3, in one of the most sought after areas of Tirana. It is located on the 14th floor of a modern building, with an area of ​​120.8 m² and a parking space of 12.5 m² on the -1st floor, included in the price. The apartment offers a view of Tirana Lake and Air Albania Stadium, natural lighting and very good orientation. The arrangement includes living room with kitchen, bedroom with wardrobe, toilet, laundry and balcony, with the possibility of conversion to 2+1. Ideal for residence or long-term investment.
